subject.title: fix(logging): boot credentials lose exact-value redaction after transient secret churn

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this two-tier, independently 512-entry durable/transient redaction policy, with audit identity and SecretRef-resolved values classified as durable credentials?
rationale: The observed leak is real and the implementation is focused, but selecting which secrets outlive workload churn and how their retention remains bounded is a security lifecycle policy rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Approve the bounded durable tier
options.body: Accept the two-tier policy and caller classification, then merge after the remaining required checks complete.

options.body: Ask for a revised design that ties durable registration and retirement to explicit credential owners before merging.
